answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit and prove sustained useful work before it can vote or earn. A periodic pulse check verifies liveness and past contributions, so a flood of fresh identities cannot instantly gain weight. Like light through a prism, one reputation splits into verifiable history, stake, and peer endorsements; forging all three is costly. Trust at saffron grade is earned slowly, so an attacker must pay real time and capital per identity, making a Sybil swarm uneconomical.
